what.en: An earthquake is when the ground suddenly shakes. It happens when huge rocks deep under the ground slip and move.
what.fil: Ang lindol ay ang biglaang pagyanig ng lupa. Nangyayari ito kapag gumagalaw ang malalaking bato sa ilalim ng lupa.

signs.en: Earthquakes usually come with no warning. The first sign is shaking, rattling windows, or things swinging and falling.
signs.fil: Kadalasan, walang babala ang lindol. Ang unang senyales ay pagyanig, kumakalampag na bintana, o umuugoy at nahuhulog na gamit.

before.en: Find the safe spots in each room, like under a sturdy table. Pack a Go Bag and practice earthquake drills.
before.fil: Hanapin ang ligtas na lugar sa bawat silid, tulad ng ilalim ng matibay na mesa. Maghanda ng Go Bag at mag-ensayo ng earthquake drill.

during.en: Duck, Cover, and Hold! Get under a sturdy table, cover your head, and hold on until the shaking stops. Stay away from windows.
during.fil: Duck, Cover, and Hold! Pumunta sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa, takpan ang ulo, at kumapit hanggang tumigil ang pagyanig. Lumayo sa bintana.

after.en: Walk out calmly with your teacher to an open area. Watch out for aftershocks, broken glass, and fallen wires.
after.fil: Lumabas nang mahinahon kasama ang guro papunta sa bukas na lugar. Mag-ingat sa aftershock, basag na salamin, at nahulog na kable.

signoff.en: Remember: Duck, Cover, and Hold — every time!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: Duck, Cover, and Hold — sa bawat pagkakataon!

dos.en: Stay away from windows and shelves
Go to an open area after the shaking
dos.fil: Pumunta sa bukas na lugar pagkatapos ng pagyanig

donts.en: Don't run while the ground is shaking
Don't go back inside until it's safe
donts.fil: Huwag bumalik sa loob hangga't hindi ligtas
